load_imas_data: load IMAS data from a netCDF file and return core profiles data for a given tree name
profile_conditions_from_IMAS: extract profile conditions from loaded IMAS core profiles data
plasma_composition_from_IMAS: extract plasma composition including impurity species from IMAS core profiles data
build_config_with_imas_geometry: build a torax config dictionary using IMAS geometry type and filepath
build_config_with_plasma_composition: build a torax config with plasma composition including main ions and impurity species
